name: Voxel Mesh Generation with Interior Face Culling
definition: A method to convert a set of 2D pixel coordinates into a 3D triangle mesh representing a voxelized image, where each pixel corresponds to a 1mm cube. Interior faces between adjacent same-group pixels are culled to minimize triangle count.
summary: Voxel Mesh Generation with Interior Face Culling converts 2D pixel grids into efficient 3D triangle meshes by emitting only exterior faces and culling interior ones between adjacent pixels.
